answer: Like a lantern marking safe ground on a shifting dune, the bond ledger lights honest actors, and a bridge contract slashes stakes when duplicate identities are proven, making mass fake accounts economically ruinous rather than cheap. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified external identity before voting or earning, so a single party spinning up many wallets faces the full cost of every bond. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
